description.value:
You radiate an aura of resolve out to 30 feet, bolstering your side's fighting spirit while unraveling your foes'. Whenever you or a friendly creature within the aura makes an attack roll or saving throw, that creature may roll a d8 and add the result.

Whenever a hostile creature enters the aura or begins its turn there, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or roll a d8 and subtract the result from each attack roll and saving throw it makes until the end of your next turn; a successful save instead grants it immunity to this power for 24 hours.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 9
